review_kind: initial scoped baseline and targeted 2.0.4 follow-up port
scope: Keep Dozer native window interface and independently maintained menu bar. This report establishes the current inspected baseline, not full Rectangle feature equivalence. Future newly released window behavior must be ported or left pending, not silently exempted because it is absent here.

paths.disposition: Reviewed reference calculations. Dozer adapts halves, quarters, thirds, display transfer, centering, size steps, gaps and now vertical sixths and switchSides. Other actions/preferences remain explicitly scoped baseline differences; upstream files stay untouched.

Ported standard-window subrole fallback, AX minimum-size aliases and immediate-placement write reduction into WindowManager, WindowPlacementAdjustment and tested EnhancedUI scope. Retained Dozer validation, async recovery and selected-app ownership.

New vertical sixth action identities are represented in Dozer action enum, menus and configurable unbound shortcuts. Full upstream action catalog is reference material; current action subset is recorded as a baseline limitation.
New switchSides behavior is ported through Dozer Cycle repeated layouts setting; other upstream repeat modes are not claimed and remain baseline differences.

Initial full-source baseline inventory: app shell, updater, settings, shortcut/drag adapters, cooperative resize, resources and additional managers are preserved for review. Dozer retains its native integration; omitted runtime features and localizations are explicitly listed below rather than asserted as ported.
Preserved complete upstream tests as reference; added native Dozer regression cases for copied sixth/repeat/AX behavior. Upstream Xcode test suite is not compiled as Dozer code.
Preserved upstream build specification and package references unchanged; Dozer builds independently using project.yml and system frameworks.
Preserved upstream workflow reference data; Dozer executes only its own top-level workflows and does not run upstream maintenance instructions.

release_notes.item: Keep snap previews translucent with Reduce Transparency by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1898
release_notes.disposition: Dozer uses its own alpha-colored AppKit preview rather than upstream NSVisualEffectView; no opaque material introduced by this port. Live Reduce Transparency visual validation remains a baseline limitation.

release_notes.item: Isolate and improve optional window animations by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1886
release_notes.disposition: Ported minimum-aware immediate Accessibility placement into WindowPlacementAdjustment; retained Dozer asynchronous recovery and scoped EnhancedUI restoration. Optional animation settings remain a baseline feature difference.

release_notes.item: Avoid redundant Accessibility writes during ordinary window placement by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1899
release_notes.disposition: Ported ordinary placement write elision and AXMinSize/AXMinimumSize fitting; permission-free tests model synchronous placement, transient display limits and failed reads/writes.

release_notes.item: Add mouse button shortcuts for window actions by @harshpatel333 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1895
release_notes.disposition: Not yet implemented in the existing scoped integration: mouse-button shortcut recording and dispatch. Recorded as a baseline feature gap, not claimed as imported.

release_notes.item: Add Persian (fa) localization by @aliafshany in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1910
release_notes.disposition: Reference Persian resources preserved untouched; Dozer owns its English-native settings interface and has no equivalent localization bundle to replace.

release_notes.item: Keep snap-preview material and geometry in sync by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1900
release_notes.disposition: Dozer uses a single owned preview with explicit frame updates. Upstream material lifecycle code is reference-only; actual preview visual behavior needs native desktop validation.

release_notes.item: Add an option to snap before reaching outer screen edges by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1901
release_notes.disposition: Not yet implemented in the existing scoped integration: configurable outer-edge snap distance. Dozer retains its existing fixed snap-zone threshold; recorded as a baseline feature gap.

release_notes.disposition: Not applicable to the existing interface: Dozer has no stacked-window list. Upstream behavior remains in the reference snapshot and the absence is recorded in the feature-gap ledger.

validation: python3 -m unittest discover -s Tests/RectangleReleaseTests -v: 22 offline release/snapshot/review tests passed.
swift test: 51 tests passed, including 23 window layout cases and 9 placement cases.
make test-window-adjustment: 7/7 scoped EnhancedUI restoration checks passed without Accessibility permission.

make release: universal arm64 and x86_64 Dozer 6.1.0 build33 built and locally ad-hoc signed; codesign --verify --strict passed. Local Xcode emits unrelated CoreDevice/CoreSimulator plugin warnings but macOS build exits successfully.
Live check --tag v2.0.4 and offline snapshot verification passed. All487 snapshot files independently matched official commit Git blob SHA1s; no snapshot paths were ignored by Git.
Bundled notices generated from current MPL/MIT licenses and source provenance; update_notices.py --check passed.
limitations: Scoped baseline only: existing Dozer integration is not the complete Rectangle application. Snapshot/review status never certifies full feature parity.

Baseline feature gaps include mouse-button shortcuts, configurable outer-edge snap distance, per-edge/notch gaps, additional Rectangle actions and repeat modes, custom snap regions, app exclusions, cooperative resizing, stacking, Todo and optional animation preferences.
Dozer keeps its independently designed English-native workspace; upstream settings UI, localizations, automatic updater, product branding and build identity are not imported.

Native window movement, drag snapping in Emacs, Reduce Transparency appearance and physical multi-display behavior were not tested live in this change. Active Dozer was left running; Carbon registration and menu bar runtime checks were not rerun against it.
Installed application is unchanged; universal build is validated but not installed, notarized or published by this port setup.
